customer_reviews.name: Aman Verma
customer_reviews.title: Unreal hyper-realism sleeve! Rohit is a master.
customer_reviews.text: Rohit did an extraordinary job on my lion and compass sleeve tattoo. The shading depth and needle precision is unlike anything I've seen in Haryana. 100% painless experience and healed like a dream with the Dermalize film.
customer_reviews.studioReply: Thank you Aman! Honored to bring your lion piece to life. Keep rocking the sleeve!

customer_reviews.name: Neha Sharma
customer_reviews.title: Delicate fine-line botanicals & zero discomfort
customer_reviews.text: Got a fine-line collarbone floral piece with Sneha. She was incredibly gentle, took time to adjust the stencil 4 times till it was millimeter-perfect. Super clean studio with autoclave sterilization visible everywhere.
customer_reviews.studioReply: We love delicate placement work! Thank you for trusting us with your first floral piece Neha.

customer_reviews.name: Sahil Rajput
customer_reviews.title: Flawless tiger realism and unmatched studio hygiene
customer_reviews.text: Best tattoo studio in Hisar without doubt. Sterile needles opened right in front of me, medical barrier films on all equipment, and the contrast in the tiger's fur is jaw-dropping.

customer_reviews.name: Pooja Bishnoi
customer_reviews.title: Microblading & Lip Blush look so natural!
customer_reviews.text: I was nervous about permanent makeup, but Sneha explained the organic pigment tones and undertones so thoroughly. My ombre powder brows healed beautifully and save me 20 minutes every morning!
customer_reviews.studioReply: Natural enhancement is our goal! So thrilled you are loving the brows and blush Pooja.

customer_reviews.name: Deepak Mor
customer_reviews.title: Phoenix Academy 3-month course launched my tattoo career
customer_reviews.text: Travelled from Rohtak for the Phoenix Tattoo Academy certification. Real hands-on machine calibration, artificial skin practice, hygiene exams, and live model supervision. Rohit sir is a mentor who genuinely cares about your growth.
customer_reviews.studioReply: Proud to have you represent the Phoenix alumni in Rohtak Deepak! Keep creating magic.

customer_reviews.name: Vikas Chahal
customer_reviews.title: Lord Shiva portrait realism brought goosebumps
customer_reviews.text: Travelled all the way from Jind. Rohit bhaiya's portraiture of Mahadev is unbelievable—the depth in the eyes and trident sacred geometry is magnificent. Worth every single rupee and kilometer travelled.

customer_reviews.name: Ananya Sethi
customer_reviews.title: Better than high-end studios in Delhi NCR
customer_reviews.text: Discovered Phoenix Tattooz through Instagram and drove down. World-class setup, hospital-clean hygiene, warm coffee lounge, and artists who listen without ego. My constellation piece healed razor sharp.

customer_reviews.name: Rajesh Kumar
customer_reviews.title: Master cover-up of a 10-year old faded tattoo
customer_reviews.text: Had a disastrous blurry tattoo from college days. Rohit designed a dynamic Japanese koi and dragon cover-up that completely swallowed the old ink. People can't believe there was an old tattoo underneath!

custom_artists.name: Rohit Sharma

custom_artists.bio: Rohit started his journey in 2019 with a simple passion — art and self-expression. Over the years, he has developed his skills, style and a loyal client base. about_settings.homeAboutParagraph1: Phoenix Tattooz Studio & Academy is a creative space in Hisar, Haryana, where art, passion and self-expression come together. We specialize in custom tattoos with a focus on quality, hygiene and a comfortable experience for every client.
about_settings.homeAboutParagraph2: Along with our studio, we run a dedicated academy to help aspiring artists learn, grow and build their skills in the world of tattooing.
about_settings.aboutStoryParagraph1: Phoenix Tattooz Studio & Academy was founded in 2019 with a simple vision — to create a space where art, creativity and self-expression come together. What started as a passion for tattooing has now grown into a trusted studio and academy, known for its quality, hygiene and artistic excellence in Hisar, Haryana.
about_settings.aboutStoryParagraph2: We are not just about tattoos, we are about people, their stories, and the art that brings them to life.
about_settings.aboutHeroDescription: More than just a tattoo studio, we are a creative space where art meets passion. We help you express your story through ink, with safety, professionalism and unmatched artistry.

studio_philosophy.heading: Our Thoughts & Views: The Phoenix Philosophy
studio_philosophy.subtitle: “Same Skin Different Story” — Artistry Grounded in Reverence, Medical-Grade Hygiene, and Unwavering Respect.
studio_philosophy.founderQuote: A tattoo is not merely ink pushed into the dermis; it is an intimate, permanent milestone of your life's journey. At Phoenix, our sacred pledge is to treat your body with medical sterility, honest artistic counsel, and master-level craft.

pillars.title: Same Skin, Different Story
pillars.summary: Every client who walks into our Hisar studio carries unique memories, triumphs, or memorials. We reject cookie-cutter Google copy-pastes. Every custom piece is drafted from your soul, contoured to your natural muscular flow and skin tone.

pillars.title: Hospital-Grade Sterile Sanctuary
pillars.summary: We operate with the hygiene standards of a surgical theater. 100% single-use EO-sterilized needle cartridges, class-B autoclave sanitation, medical barrier plastics, and cruelty-free vegan inks imported from USA/Europe.

pillars.title: Lifelong Brotherhood & Aftercare
pillars.tagline: Our Commitment Doesn't End at Checkout
pillars.summary: Every tattoo comes with hospital-grade Dermalize second-skin healing film, detailed aftercare booklets, 24/7 direct artist WhatsApp guidance, and our lifetime free touch-up guarantee.

pillars.title: Elevating the Profession at Phoenix Academy
pillars.summary: Tattooing is a dignified fine art. Through our Academy, we train young aspiring artists across Haryana in dermatological anatomy, sterile cross-contamination prevention, machine mechanics, and ethical client care.
